name: aave-base-liquidation-research
description: Read-only research tooling: watches Aave V3 on Base, replays real liquidations on local Anvil forks, and measures how much of the value a competing bot could capture.

scripts.report:liquidations: docker compose exec watcher node dist/scripts/liquidationReport.js
scripts.benchmark:solvers: docker compose exec watcher node dist/scripts/solverBenchmark.js
scripts.snapshot:dbs: docker compose exec watcher node dist/scripts/snapshotDbs.js
